reason: Re-rolled 2026-09-29 against devaudit-cli 1.7.3 (was 1.7.1) after upstream restructured this template's env block and step order (metasession-dev/DevAudit-Installer#921). Two fixes carried forward from the original patch: (1) the unsharded 'E2E Regression Tests' step's default bash -e shell loses the playwright exit code without an explicit `|| STATUS=$?` per invocation (still present in 1.7.3's base template — upstream has not fixed this). (2) Shards the full, unscoped `regression` Playwright project (deployment_status trigger, or unscoped workflow_dispatch) into 4 shards, restarting the dev server between each, per the e2e-ci-reliability skill's diagnostic playbook — wawagardenbar-app#832 diagnosed the unsharded 576-test/38-min single-worker run as accumulated process/connection-degradation. The critical tier and scoped workflow_dispatch runs are left unsharded. Also fixed in this re-roll: upstream 1.7.3's new `{{E2E_REGRESSION_JOB_ENV}}` merge duplicated `MONGODB_DB_NAME` (present in both sdlc-config.json's `app_env` and `e2e_env`), producing invalid YAML — removed the duplicate (kept `e2e_env`'s value, which this workflow actually uses). This is repo-specific tuning on top of the generated template, not yet a generalized DevAudit-Installer feature; re-roll again against upstream if/when the generator grows native sharding support or fixes the STATUS-capture bug natively.
